purpose: Machine-readable summary of the current AutoStop CRM MCP surface used by the manager agent.
operation_notes: Always use ping_connector/get_connector_identity/get_runtime_status when connector availability or auth behavior is uncertain.
Start broad CRM orientation with bootstrap_context, get_board_context, or review_board.
Use search_cards, search_clients, get_card_context, get_client, and list_repair_orders before heavy board exports.
Use shared_files tools for shared documents and card attachment tools for card-local attachments; do not paste file bytes into notes unless required.
Use client_directory and client_vehicle_linking tools before creating duplicate clients or vehicles.
Use set_card_board_summary only after reading the target card and keep it under 5 non-empty lines.
For the owner commands Приберись, прибейсь, and переберись, treat description and board_summary as separate outputs: rich-text detailed recoverable card text plus short plain operator preview.
Do not move or archive cards during routine cleanup unless the owner gives a separate explicit target/action.
If a VIN/chassis/frame number exists and vehicle_profile engine_model, gearbox_model, or drivetrain is empty, enrich only from source-backed data and preserve manual_fields.

Use decode_vehicle_identity locally before VIN-critical parts lookup when the vehicle is ROW/JDM, vPIC is partial, or CRM/manual data conflicts; verify production CRM server has the updated AutostopManager mount before relying on it through the CRM MCP endpoint.

Use catalog_provider_status and plan_oem_parts_providers locally before claiming live VIN/OEM/supplier API access; use public_aftermarket_catalog_lookup for MANN-FILTER/DENSO brand-scope catalog enrichment; use partsapi_catalog_lookup only when PARTSAPI_KEY/PARTSAPI_BASE_URL are configured or dry-run is enough; use vin17_decode_vehicle and vin17_search_part_number_by_vin only when VIN17_ACCOUNT/VIN17_SECRET are configured or dry-run is enough; verify production CRM server has the updated AutostopManager mount before relying on these through the CRM MCP endpoint.

Use benchmark_vin_parts_lookup locally for 10-card or batch VIN/frame quality checks; it redacts raw identifiers and reports identity coverage, safe public query coverage, dry-run adapter readiness, and missing live catalog/supplier credentials.

Use build_vin_parts_work_order locally after benchmark to get per-card OEM/EPC routes, prepared API checks, cross/applicability steps, supplier sequence, CRM writeback gates, and acceptance checklists before doing live lookups.
Use today_context/memory_context_for/recall/remember/learn_from_feedback only for durable non-CRM manager memory and lessons.
Treat the autostopcrm-v1 branch in the CRM repo as canonical for new MCP commands and connector behavior.
Refresh this catalog whenever the CRM repo or AutostopManager MCP tool surface changes.

For CRM VIN/frame/body-number parts lookup and writeback planning, use plan_crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup locally; verify production CRM server has the updated AutostopManager mount before relying on it through the CRM MCP endpoint.

Use estimate_repair_work_cost for read-only labor estimates with public price averaging and public norm-hours/labor-time plausibility; do not call replace_repair_order_works from a pricing estimate unless the owner separately approves the exact ЗН write.

schema_notes.live_discovery_rule: Before CRM writes, prefer the currently exposed MCP/tool schema over stale docs or static wrappers.
schema_notes.set_card_deadline: Deadline-capable CRM tools accept duration-style payloads such as days/hours/minutes/seconds or total_seconds on the live connector; wrapper metadata may render the field loosely.
schema_notes.write_scope: All CRM tools operate only on the current AutoStop CRM board served by this MCP/API endpoint.
